mapper.select: SELECT user_search_history_id, user_no, target_user_no, target_tag_id, searched_at FROM ultary_user_search_history WHERE user_search_history_id = #{userSearchHistoryId} AND user_no = #{viewerUserNo}
mapper.sql: FROM ultary_user_search_history h LEFT JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = h.target_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ultary_tag t ON t.tag_id = h.target_tag_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ultary_user tag_creator ON tag_creator.user_no = t.created_by_user_no WHERE h.user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND ( ( h.target_user_no IS NOT NULL AND u.user_no IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_block b WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND ( b.blocker_user_no = h.target_user_no AND b.blocked_user_no = #{viewerUserNo} ) ) ) OR ( h.target_tag_id IS NOT NULL AND t.tag_id IS NOT NULL AND (tag_creator.user_no IS NULL OR tag_creator.withdrawal_status <> 'SUSPENDED') ) )

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ultary_feed_tag ft INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = ft.feed_id INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = f.user_no WHERE ft.tag_id = h.target_tag_id AND ft.is_deleted = 0 AND ) AS feedCount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_user_search_history ( user_no, target_user_no, target_tag_id, searched_at ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{targetUserNo}, NULL, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE searched_at = NOW()
INSERT INTO ultary_user_search_history ( user_no, target_user_no, target_tag_id, searched_at ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, NULL, #{targetTagId}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE searched_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT h.user_search_history_id, 'USER' AS historyType, h.target_user_no, u.nickname, ( SELECT rp.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet rp WHERE rp.user_no = u.user_no AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.priority ASC, rp.pet_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profileFileId, NULL AS target_tag_id, NULL AS hashtag, h.searched_at FROM ultary_user_search_history h INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = h.target_user_no WHERE h.user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND h.target_user_no = #{targetUserNo}

SELECT h.user_search_history_id, 'TAG' AS historyType, NULL AS target_user_no, NULL AS nickname, NULL AS profileFileId, h.target_tag_id, t.hashtag, , h.searched_at FROM ultary_user_search_history h INNER JOIN ultary_tag t ON t.tag_id = h.target_tag_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE h.user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND h.target_tag_id = #{targetTagId}
